Physical residual detection and manual clearance execute, but runtime cannot inject and preserve an exact pre-existing token location outside normal ingress seeding.
PLC-internal machine status and fault-code producers are present in IR, but no target HMI register, transport, or consumer binding is validated.
phase-2.v1 requires restart_semantics and cannot directly express a one-shot finite batch whose next run requires external replenishment and runtime recreation.
